description: This file defines tasks for building, cleaning, and managing documentation using Sphinx, including functions for building, rebuilding, autobuilding, browsing, saving, and updating translations of documentation. It uses invoke for task management and interacts with external tools like sphinx-build and sphinx-intl.

methods.name: _sphinxdoc_get_language
methods.description: Utility to determine the language for sphinx documentation, defaulting to environment or default setting.

methods.name: _sphinxdoc_get_destdir
methods.description: Utility to determine the destination directory for built documentation based on builder and language.
